label: Judgement problem solving - Clinical dementia rating (CDR) - Insight46 phase 2
meta_rows: Judgement problem solving - Clinical dementia rating (CDR) - Insight46 phase 2

Insight46 phase 2 clinical dementia rating (CDR) - a global scale which assesses dementia severity via an interview with participant and informant. Performance is rated in six domains (memory, orientation, judgement and problem solving, community activities, home and hobbies, and personal care) and then a global CDR score is calculated by combining the scores from each domain using an establish scoring algorithm. Not measured at phase 1.
cat_rows: This category contains information about the AD8 dementia screening interview and Clinical Dementia Rating Scale carried out by the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
